description_en: Submits a job to add media
name: AddMedia

parameters.help_en:
The path of the input file. You can obtain the path from the ApsaraVideo Media Processing or OSS console. For detailed trigger rules, see Workflow trigger matching rules below.

Only OSS HTTP addresses are supported. CDN addresses and HTTPS addresses are not supported.
The value cannot exceed 3,200 bytes.
The URL must comply with RFC 2396 (UTF-8 encoded and URL-encoded). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.help_zh:
输入文件的路径，可以通过MPS或OSS控制台获取。详细触发规则请参见下文中工作流触发匹配规则。

仅支持OSS HTTP地址，不支持CDN地址和HTTPS地址。
不超过3200字节。
URL遵循RFC 2396（UTF-8编码，并进行URLEncode）。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en:
The media title.

The value cannot exceed 128 bytes.
UTF-8 encoded
parameters.help_zh:
媒体标题。

长度限制不超过128个字节。
UTF-8编码
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en:
The description.

The value cannot exceed 1,024 bytes.
UTF-8 encoded
parameters.help_zh:
描述。

长度限制不超过1024个字节。
UTF-8编码
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The cover URL. This is the storage address of the cover that you want to set. You can obtain the address from ApsaraVideo Media Processing console > Workflow Management > Media Bucket or OSS console > My Access Path.

The value cannot exceed 3,200 bytes.
The URL must comply with RFC 2396 (UTF-8 encoded and URL-encoded). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.help_zh:
封面URL。即您需要设置的封面的存储地址，可以通过MPS控制台 > 工作流管理 > 媒体Bucket或OSS控制台 > 我的访问路径获取。

不超过3200字节。
URL遵循RFC 2396（UTF-8编码，并进行URLEncode）。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.name: cover_url

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags.

In ApsaraVideo Media Processing, each tag of each media is independent. You can search the Media Library to find all media that have the same tag.

Separate multiple tags with commas (,). A maximum of 16 tags are supported.
Each tag cannot exceed 32 bytes.

UTF-8 encoded
parameters.help_zh:
标签列表。

媒体处理中，每个媒体的每个标签都是独立的，可以通过搜索媒体库来查找所有设置了相同标签的媒体。

用半角逗号（,）分隔，不超过16个标签。
单个标签不能超过32个字节。

UTF-8编码
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en:
The media workflow ID. You can obtain the ID from the ApsaraVideo Media Processing console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44437.html operation.

This parameter task is an https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027615.html. After submission, the task is not completed immediately and is queued for asynchronous execution in the background
parameters.help_zh:
媒体工作流ID。可通过MPS控制台或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44437.html接口获取。

该参数任务为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027615.html，提交后任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行
parameters.name: media_workflow_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom data of the media workflow.

The value cannot exceed 1,024 bytes.
UTF-8 encoded
parameters.help_zh:
媒体工作流用户自定义数据。

不超过1024字节。
UTF-8编码
parameters.name: media_workflow_user_data

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to check that the specified workflow supports the input path. Set this parameter to true to avoid errors caused by incorrect paths. Valid values:

true: Check.

false: Do not check
parameters.help_zh:
是否检查指定的工作流支持输入路径。此处建议您选择检查（true），避免因路径出错而导致的错误。取值：

true：检查

false：不检查
parameters.name: input_unbind

parameters.help_en: The category ID of the media. Negative values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 媒体所属类目ID。不允许为负数
parameters.name: cate_id

parameters.help_en:
The override parameters.

Example 1: HLS packaging caption override `{"WebVTTSubtitleOverrides",[{"RefActivityName":"subtitleNode","WebVTTSubtitleURL":"http://test.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/example1.vtt"}]}`.
Example 2: DASH packaging caption override `{"subtitleTransNodeName":{"InputConfig":{"Format":"stl","InputFile":{"URL":"http://subtitleBucket.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/package/example/CENG.stl"}}}}`
parameters.help_zh:
覆盖参数。

示例1：HLS打包字幕覆盖`{“WebVTTSubtitleOverrides”,[{“RefActivityName”:”subtitleNode”,”WebVTTSubtitleURL”:”http://test.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/example1.vtt"}]}`。
示例2：DASH打包字幕覆盖` {“subtitleTransNodeName”:{“InputConfig”:{“Format”:”stl”,”InputFile”:{“URL”:”http://subtitleBucket.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/package/example/CENG.stl"}}}}`
parameters.name: override_params

CensorState.description_en:
The video moderation status. Valid values:

Initiated: Initiated. The video is uploaded but moderation is not completed.

Pass: Passed. The video is uploaded and has passed moderation
CensorState.description_zh:
视频审核状态。取值：

Initiated：初始（上传成功审核未完成）。

Pass：通过（上传成功审核已通过）

Description.description_en: The description. The value cannot exceed 1,024 bytes
Description.description_zh: 描述。长度不超过1024个字节

Duration.description_en: The duration of the media file

State.description_en: The file status. The default value is Normal
State.description_zh: 文件状态。此处默认为Normal（正常）

Format.description_en: The format. Supported formats: mov, mp4, m4a, 3gp, 3g2, and mj2

Fps.description_en: The frame rate of the media file

Height.description_en: The height of the media file

PublishState.description_en:
The media publish status, which indicates whether the media is published externally. Valid values:

Initiated: Initiated.
UnPublish: Unpublished. The OSS playback file permission is Private.
Published: Published. The OSS playback file permission is Default
PublishState.description_zh:
媒体发布状态，表示是否对外发布媒体。取值：

Initiated：初始。
UnPublish：未发布，OSS播放文件权限为Private。
Published：已发布，OSS播放文件权限为Default

Size.description_en: The size of the media file

Title.description_en: The media title. The value cannot exceed 128 bytes
Title.description_zh: 媒体标题。长度不超过128个字节

Width.description_en: The width of the media file
